# City Play Co.

> City Play Co. creates live, hosted city games for playful adults in St. Petersburg, Florida.

## Games

- St. Pete Detective Club: a live detective game and walking mystery through Downtown St. Pete. The first case, The Sea-Vamp Syndicate, has already been played. The next case date is not announced yet; follow https://www.instagram.com/cityplayco/ or join the email list at https://cityplayco.com/.
- The Banishment of Johnny Prime: a one-night Halloween party game built by City Play Co., played on phones. Saturday, October 31, 2026, 6:30 PM to midnight Eastern, finale at 11:11 PM, at the Home of Get Psyched in St. Petersburg (address by Instagram DM). Page: https://cityplayco.com/johnny_halloween/

- Official site: https://cityplayco.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cityplayco/

## Policies

- Event terms: https://cityplayco.com/event-terms.html
